Subject: Thanks — POC recap & proposed success criteria / next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before the trial kicks off:

Summary from call:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and triage routing (throughput + accuracy).
- Duration: 3-week POC (sandbox, subset of 10k notes, endpoint-only integration).

Proposed success criteria (draft — attached spreadsheet):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end request latency < 250ms for 512-token window under 50 RPS load.
2) Accuracy: targeted ROUGE/clinical-extraction F1 >= baseline +8%.
3) Stability: no more than 1% error rate (5xx / timeouts) during sustained runs.
4) Cost: estimated per-1M tokens cost < $X (we'll refine after initial run).

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Acme: provide sample dataset + evaluation set (Tom) and internal success raters.
- Redwood: provide sandbox endpoints, data ingestion guide, and bi-weekly metrics report (Marcus: SE support).
- Joint: weekly sync + final readout presentation for execs at POC close.

Timing (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize mutual action plan and sign starter SOW for POC (DocuSign link included).
- Week 1–3: run integration + evaluation.
- Week 4: final readout meeting and go/no-go decision.

Next steps for this week:
1) Tom — confirm dataset delivery date (by Tue EOD PT).
2) Sarah — confirm exec readout attendees and preferred week for final review (week of 5/17 or 5/24).
3) Marcus — send sandbox endpoints and onboarding checklist; prep SE hours estimate.
4) I’ll send the mutual action plan and success criteria file (attached) and a draft calendar invite for the readout.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Redwood_POC_Guide_v1.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
